content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.4 TEST - Build 265
Preserves the advisory Expansion Planner and selected-station Supply filters from Build 264, and adds one bounded final DockedMenu owner reconciliation for mod compatibility.
- Registers immediately on the available Dock Interactions menu, then checks exactly once after UI startup settles. - If another UI mod replaced DockedMenu, EOC registers once on that final active owner. - Adds no watcher, polling loop, per-frame hook, recurring scan, plot placement, construction authority, hidden resources, or unauthorized credit movement. - Supply analysis remains explicit Run/Refresh only and Raw Scrap remains excluded.
Build 265 requires complete live proof before promotion.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
content.author: RazorEQX
